Name: Pokemon - Day Care
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pokemon Day Care[/b][/size][/center]

[center]Turn your farm into a Pokémon day care! Battle, catch and raise the wild Pokémon living in the valley. [/center]
[center]Earn badges, fill your Pokédex, take on the Leagues and rebuild your grandfather's Pokémon Day Care![/center]

[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]The successor to Eggventure[/color][/b][/size]

Pokemon Day Care is the successor to Pokemon Eggventure. Found eggs are still there, but they take a back seat. Eggventure is no longer updated. Eggventure saves are converted automatically. Still, I recommend starting a new save.

Older Eggventure versions are still available in the Files tab, under Old files.

[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Updating from Eggventure[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Playing Eggventure? Read this before installing.[/b]

[list=1]
[*]First delete every old Eggventure folder: Pokemon Eggventure - Day Care, [FTM] Pokemon Eggventure, [FTM] Pokemon Eggventure - SVE and the old modules. If you keep them, Pokémon and spawns will be doubled.[/*]
[*]Install Pokemon Day Care.[/*]
[*]Load your save: it is converted automatically (Pokémon, eggs, products, chests, machines, planted berries, museum donations, collections and bundles). You will be asked to pick your difficulty once.[/*]
[/list]
Back up your save first, just in case.

[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Features[/color][/b][/size]

[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]The start of your adventure[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]The day after you arrive in Stardew Valley, Marnie is waiting at your door to start your adventure.[/*]
[*]Pick your difficulty: Easy, Normal or Hard.[/*]
[*]Pick your first partner among the starters of every generation, or let chance draw one from every base-stage Pokémon.[/*]
[*]Optional Nuzlocke and Randomizer modes.[/*]
[*]Professor Oak sends you your grandfather's journal and a Pokédex, and off you go![/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Help the valley or join Team Rocket[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Your rival comes back to the valley, 10 years after leaving for the Kanto League.[/*]
[*]Team Rocket has set up shop in Pelican Town.[/*]
[*]Community Center route: foil their plans and protect the valley.[/*]
[*]Joja route: join their ranks and become friends with Jessie, James and Meowth.[/*]
[*]Two ways to live the story, following your choice in the base game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Catching and battling[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Wild Pokémon everywhere: the valley, the mines, the Skull Cavern and the volcano. Walk up to them to start a battle.[/*]
[*]Turn-based battles: types, abilities, natures, IVs and EVs, status conditions, weather, double battles.[/*]
[*]Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax and Terastallization.[/*]
[*]Your lead Pokémon follows you everywhere, fights monsters by your side and has its own passive that helps you explore.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Pokémon and the Pokédex[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Over 1200 Pokémon, with their regional, alternate, Mega and Gigantamax forms.[/*]
[*]Each species has its own biome, season, weather and time of day: every corner of the valley has its own Pokémon.[/*]
[*]Beaches, lakes and rivers to explore with a water Pokémon mount.[/*]
[*]A Pokédex built into the team menu, rated by Professor Oak, with rewards to earn.[/*]
[*]The Poké Radar to find the rarest ones, shinies included.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Side quests and events[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]New characters in the valley, with their own dialogue and heart events.[/*]
[*]Day care clients: villagers come to ask you for specific Pokémon to solve their problems.[/*]
[*]Villager quests and daily, weekly and seasonal missions.[/*]
[*]The daily Pokémon Gazette and its breeder tips.[/*]
[*]Easter eggs and nods to the Pokémon games hidden all over the valley.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Gyms, Leagues and trainers[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Villagers as gym leaders, each with their own type and badge.[/*]
[*]One League per region, with its Elite Four and Champion (3 Leagues so far).[/*]
[*]Trainers in the wild and in the mines to challenge you.[/*]
[*]The Battle Tower: battle streaks and famous trainers from the games.[/*]
[*]Tera Raids, some mornings, somewhere in the valley.[/*]
[*]Special trainers to meet: the mod's creator herself and players from the Discord community.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Legendaries[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Almost every legendary and mythical Pokémon can be found.[/*]
[*]Each in its own way: a villager's letter, an item to bring to the right place, a night event, a faraway island, a roaming legendary...[/*]
[*]A Legends of the Valley tab tracks your progress.[/*]
[*]They open up once the main story is complete.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Mounts and bicycle[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Pick your mount at the stable: Mudsdale on land, Lapras on water.[/*]
[*]The bicycle at Robin's, to get around fast without a mount.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Crafting and farming[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Your Pokémon live in your coops and barns.[/*]
[*]Every day they produce resources and energies of their type.[/*]
[*]Each Pokémon type has a day care talent: watering, harvesting, orchards, beehives, machines... The more it loves you, the more it helps at the day care.[/*]
[*]Grow Berries and Apricorns: plant them, harvest them and use them in cooking and crafting.[/*]
[*]Breeding at the PC: eggs with inherited moves and IVs, to hatch in the incubator.[/*]
[*]The Breeding skill speeds up breeding and hatching.[/*]
[*]Craft your own Balls and remedies with energies, Berries and foraged items.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][color=#e3350d]Multiplayer[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]A shared day care: the PC, the boxes, breeding and the Pokédex are shared.[/*]
[*]Every catch, every hatch and every shiny counts for everyone.[/*]
[*]Everyone has their own team, partner and mount.[/*]
[*]Team up in the same battle, or face each other in a duel.[/*]
[*]Breed together: two parents from different trainers make more eggs, and far more shinies![/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]SpaceCore[/*]
[*]Item Extensions[/*]
[*]Extra Animal Config[/*]
[*]Extra Machine Config[/*]
[*]Farm Type Manager[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, recommended for the settings)[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]My other mods[/color][/b][/size]

Optional, they work with the Day Care.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54184]Pokemon Day Care - Fish[/url]: fish become Pokémon, and fish ponds give eggs.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53614]Pokemon Day Care - Interface[/url]: the whole interface in Pokémon colours.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49732]Pokemon Day Care - Pets[/url]: a Pokémon companion instead of a cat or dog, and it evolves.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39552]Pokemon Day Care - Junimo[/url]: Junimos become Unown or Pichu.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31253]Pokemon Day Care - Bobbers[/url]: Poké Balls as fishing bobbers.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39208]Pokemon Day Care - Digspots[/url]: artifact spots become Poké Balls or Diglett.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39575]Pokemon Day Care - Gift Box[/url]: the gift box becomes a Poké Ball.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54142]Pokemon Day Care - Resource[/url]: grass, stones and ore nodes in the style of the Pokémon games.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Coming next[/color][/b][/size]

The mod keeps growing. Here is what's planned for the next updates:

[list]
[*]New Pokémon mounts to choose at the stable[/*]
[*]More crafting recipes[/*]
[*]New NPCs for the expansions: Sunberry Village, East Scarp, Mount Vapius and Ridgeside Village[/*]
[*]New Pokémon for the community's best-known NPCs, like Alecto, Sen, Wren, Dao and more[/*]
[*]New stories for the legendaries that don't have one yet[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Become a trainer in the mod![/color][/b][/size]

Want to appear in the game? I can create a trainer for you (solo or duo) that players will face at the Battle Tower or along the way. Leave a comment with:

[list]
[*]your nickname[/*]
[*]your 6 Pokémon[/*]
[*]a catchphrase, the line your trainer will say before the battle[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the required mods.[/*]
[*]Unzip the archive into your Mods folder. You get a "Pokemon Day Care" folder with three mods inside: the content pack, the Farm Type Manager pack and the C# modules. Keep them together.[/*]
[*]Start a new save, or load an existing one: Marnie comes to your door the next morning.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Uninstalling[/color][/b][/size]

The mod's Pokémon items and buildings turn into Error Items. Back up your save before removing the mod.

[size=5][b][color=#3b4cca]Found a bug, have a question?[/color][/b][/size]

Have a great adventure in the valley!
